plan.notes: Source: Idaho State University Department of Computer Science official '4-year Degree Plan: BS in Computer Science, BS in Artificial Intelligence Sciences w/ CS Concentration, and CS Cybersecurity Certificate (26-27)' PDF — https://www.isu.edu/media/libraries/college-of-science-and-engineering/computer-science/documents/BSAIS-BSCS-CyberCert-4YrPlan26-27.pdf — the department's published term-by-term sequence for the BS in Computer Science (listed first in the plan title), downloaded and manually transcribed on 2026-09-30. Cross-checked against the 2026-27 ISU catalog 'B.S. Computer Science' requirements page (https://coursecat.isu.edu/undergraduate/scienceengineering/computerscience/bs-computer-science/), which confirms the degree name 'B.S. Computer Science' (Pocatello, ID), 120 total credits, and the catalog titles/credits of the major courses. IMPORTANT: the source plan is a COMBINED plan for the BSCS plus the BSAIS-with-CS-concentration plus the CS Cybersecurity Certificate. Every row was transcribed exactly as printed in the plan (nothing invented, no rows added or dropped). Rows beyond the catalog's BSCS core — CS 1185, MATH 3332, MATH 4405, CS 4433, CS 4470, CS 4472, CS 4478, and the CS 4417/CS 4434 option — are marked category 'elective'; they serve the AI-sciences concentration / cybersecurity-certificate tracks in the combined plan, and for a pure BSCS student they occupy the catalog's '9 additional CS elective credits' + free-elective slots. Credits transcribed exactly as the plan prints them: the plan lists MATH 1170 and MATH 1175 at 3 credits each, while the 2026-27 catalog lists both at 4 credits each — the plan's printed semester totals sum to exactly 120. Plan title discrepancy: the plan prints 'Math1175 ... Linear Algebra' in Semester 2; MATH 1175 is Calculus II per the catalog, so it is transcribed as Calculus II. The plan's 'CS 33-0' in the CS 4478 prerequisite column is read as CS 3309. Placement/assessment: CS 1181 requires MATH 1143 or equivalent; several courses list 'Math1144/1147 or equivalent' — MATH 1143 and MATH 1144 are listed as plain external prerequisite codes; either MATH 1144 or MATH 1147 (or equivalent) satisfies the plan. ENGL 1101 lists a placement test or equivalent, kept in the notes only.
